lines.orig: Yep, nope, nah, I got you, I'm heading over (Do it anyway, do it anyway, do it anyway, do it anyway)
lines.trans: 好的 不  我知道了 我这就过去 (不管怎样 都要继续 不管怎样 都要继续)

lines.orig: The bright sun in the blue water, we fight less and love harder
lines.trans: 蓝海中闪烁的太阳 我们少点争吵 爱得更深

lines.orig: You tell me that I'm the one, I tell you it's just for fun
lines.trans: 你说我是你的唯一 我说这只是寻欢作乐

lines.orig: We walk the beach at midnight, watchin' the stars and the clear sky
lines.trans: 我们在午夜的沙滩漫步 望着繁星与晴朗夜空

lines.orig: We both say I love you, but it's alright
lines.trans: 我们都说我爱你 但没关系

lines.orig: I'll write you a song, you play it on guitar
lines.trans: 我会为你写首歌 你弹着吉他伴奏

lines.orig: You and me, we both sing along, and we hold hands for too long
lines.trans: 你和我 一起跟着唱 牵着手久久不愿放开

lines.orig: If you wanna talk, I guess that's alright, if you wanna walk under the night sky
lines.trans: 如果你想找人聊天 我想那没问题 如果你想在夜空下散步

lines.orig: I don't really care 'cause we got tonight, oh, baby, we
lines.trans: 我真的不在意 因为我们拥有今晚 宝贝 我们

lines.orig: It's just a couple months, but we do it anyway
lines.trans: 只有短短几个月 但我们还是要这样做

lines.orig: It's only for the summer, but we do it anyway
lines.trans: 虽然只是这个夏天 但我们还是要这样做

lines.orig: It's just a couple months, but we do it anyway

lines.orig: We do it anyway, d-d-do it anyway
lines.trans: 我们还是要这样做 坚持这样做

lines.orig: I got those cold drinks for them hot nights, you can hang with us if you act right
lines.trans: 我准备了冷饮来应对炎炎夏夜 你可以加入我们 但要表现好一点

lines.orig: Got long hair with them short sides, I like your style, you're from the north side
lines.trans: 长发配两侧短发 我喜欢你的风格 你来自北边

lines.orig: Sea shells, palm trees, I call you, you call me
lines.trans: 海螺与棕榈树 我给你打电话 你回我电话

lines.orig: Talk all night, mob all day, "Girl, where you at?" Boy, I'm on my way
lines.trans: 整晚诉说 整天厮混 “女孩 你在哪？” 男孩 我在路上了

lines.orig: On the beach again, never thought that this would end
lines.trans: 再次来到海滩 从没想过这一切会结束

lines.orig: Dinner by the water, wish that summer time was longer, uh
lines.trans: 海边的晚餐 真希望夏天能长久一些

lines.orig: Don't really care what we do tonight, good night kiss 'til the mood is right
lines.trans: 不在意今晚要做什么 晚安吻直到氛围恰到好处

lines.orig: Laying by the beach with you, wishing this would never end (Ooh, it would never end)
lines.trans: 和你躺在沙滩上 希望这一切永远不要结束 (永远不要结束)
